sources.title: An Arabic-English Lexicon

sources.edition: Perseus Digital Library digitization with Alpheios corrections

sources.title: Qutrub, Arramooz and Arabic Stopwords word lists
sources.author: Taha Zerrouki

sources.title: Lisān al-ʿArab
sources.author: Ibn Manẓūr (d. 711 H / 1311)
sources.caveat: The original text is public domain, but the digital copy used so far comes from a local database of unknown origin. Import full text only from a digital edition with clear terms (for example OpenITI, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, whose NonCommercial term must be checked against the project licence first).

sources.title: Al-Muʿjam al-Wasīṭ
sources.author: Majmaʿ al-Lugha al-ʿArabiyya, Cairo
sources.caveat: No verified redistribution permission. Early editions (1960-1962) may have expired under Egyptian Law 82/2002, but the 4th edition has revisions; not checked by a legal adviser.

sources.title: Al-Muʿjam al-Muḥīṭ (as named in the local database)
sources.caveat: Identity of this dictionary is not confirmed. Do not treat it as al-Qāmūs al-Muḥīṭ or Muḥīṭ al-Muḥīṭ. Links to ejtaal.net are comparison links only.

sources.title: Al-Ghanī
sources.author: ʿAbd al-Ghanī Abū al-ʿAzm
sources.caveat: Links to ejtaal.net are comparison links only; the dictionary is named in the audit note.

sources.title: A Dictionary of Modern Written Arabic
sources.author: Hans Wehr

sources.title: Arabic Almanac (ejtaal.net), scanned dictionary viewer
sources.caveat: The GPL covers the viewer code, not the scanned books. Use as a link for checking, never copy scans.

sources.title: Open Islamicate Texts Initiative
sources.caveat: Candidate source for full classical dictionary text (Lisān, Maqāyīs, Ṣiḥāḥ, Tāj al-ʿArūs). NonCommercial term must be reconciled with the project's CC BY-SA content licence before import.

sources.title: Qabas lexicographic database (Birzeit University)
sources.caveat: NoDerivatives: may be used to validate entries; do not ship adapted copies.

sources.title: Local dictionary database (lex.zip / db.sqlite, seven dictionaries)
